faq_heading: Homes near Royal Heights Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Royal Heights Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Royal Heights Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Royal Heights Elementary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: How much do homes near Royal Heights Elementary sell for?
faq.a: Within 1 km of the school, 60 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,113,000, townhomes $835,000, condos $325,900. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Royal Heights Elementary?
faq.a: Near Royal Heights Elementary (1 km), homes took a median 21 days to sell and closed at 96.4% of the list price, with 10% over asking, across 60 sales.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Royal Heights Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are L.A. Matheson Secondary (1.2 km east), Annieville Elementary (1.2 km south-west) and Home Quest (1.2 km south-west).

Royal Heights Elementary is an elementary school in Surrey (Surrey School District), at 11665 97 Ave. It teaches grades K to 7.
The search below lists homes for sale whose listing names Royal Heights Elementary. Under it are the prices homes sold for within 1 km of the school.
How the Royal Heights Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Royal Heights Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 1 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 1 km of Royal Heights Elementary sold for
Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 60 homes sold within 1 km of Royal Heights Elementary: 44 houses, 5 townhomes and 6 condos. The largest group was houses, at a median of $1,113,000.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Royal Heights Elementary

25 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Royal Heights Elementary in a straight line (15 elementary, 9 secondary, 1 other; 5 independent). The closest is L.A. Matheson Secondary, 1.2 km away, and the farthest on this list is Betty Huff Elementary, 2.9 km away. By type, the nearest elementary school is Annieville Elementary (1.2 km); the nearest independent school is Immaculate Conception School (1.7 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Devon Gardens Elementary (1.9 km). Other elementary schools close by: Annieville Elementary (1.2 km south-west), Kirkbride Elementary (1.4 km south-east), Gibson Elementary (1.4 km south), Cedar Hills Elementary (1.4 km east), Prince Charles Elementary (1.7 km east). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is Annieville Elementary, 1.2 km south-west of Royal Heights Elementary.

blocks.text: Before you offer on a home near Royal Heights Elementary

items.t: Confirm the catchment for the exact address on the Surrey school finder. A home a few blocks from Royal Heights Elementary can sit in a different catchment.
Visit on a school day at drop-off and pick-up. Traffic and parking near Royal Heights Elementary are very different at 8:30 am and 3 pm than on a Sunday viewing.

Compare price with similar homes farther from the school. The median house within 1 km of Royal Heights Elementary was $1,113,000, so check whether size and age explain a gap before you pay for the location.
Look at Annieville Elementary, the nearest other elementary school, 1.2 km south-west of Royal Heights Elementary. Compare the two when you check which school serves the address.
